exclusion_rules: All existing legacy trees, stages, reports, standalone firmware, ESP32 firmware, .git and local outputs are outside the selected scope.

self_reference_rule: Manifest excludes itself and SHA256SUMS.txt; checksums cover every file except the checksum list.
